d: As a Home Healthcare Nurse, you will provide compassionate and high-quality nursing care to patients in the comfort of their own homes. You will work closely with patients, their families, and other healthcare professionals to ensure the delivery of personalized care and support. Your primary responsibility will be to assess patients' health needs, create and implement care plans, monitor their progress, and provide education and emotional support to patients and their families
Conduct thorough patient assessments to identify healthcare needs and develop individualized care plans.
Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by physicians.
Monitor patient vital signs and condition, and promptly report any changes to the healthcare team.
Educate patients and their families on healthcare issues, treatment plans, and self-care techniques.
Provide emotional support and guidance to patients and families during challenging times.
Ensure patients understand discharge instructions and follow-up care
Work collaboratively with physicians, therapists, and other healthcare team members to coordinate patient care.
Communicate effectively with colleagues to ensure seamless transitions of care and optimal patient outcomes.
Participate in interdisciplinary meetings to discuss patient progress and treatment plans
Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records, including medical histories, assessments, and care plans.
Document all nursing interventions, medications administered, and patient responses to treatment.
Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements regarding patient documentation.
Adhere to strict infection control protocols to prevent the spread of healthcare-associated infections.
Implement safety measures to protect patients, staff, and visitors from accidents and injuries.
Identify and address potential safety hazards in the healthcare environment
Pursue ongoing education and training to stay abreast of advancements in nursing practice and healthcare technology.
Seek opportunities for professional growth and skill development through workshops, seminars, and certifications.
Maintain current licensure and certifications required for the position
Participate in quality improvement initiatives to enhance patient care and safety.
Adhere to hospital policies, procedures, and standards of practice.
Assist in the implementation of evidence-based practices to improve patient outcomes and satisfaction
q: Current and valid SCFHS nursing license
Minimum 2 Years, preferably in home health care setting
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills.
Proficiency in using electronic health records (EHR) and other healthcare technology.
Ability to work independently and adapt to changing patient needs and environments.

d: Copart, Inc. a technology leader and the premier online vehicle auction platform globally, with over 200 facilities located across the world, Copart links vehicle sellers to more than 750,000 buyers in over 190 countries. We believe in providing an unmatched experience, every day and everywhere, driven by our people, processes, and technology.

The Vehicle Receiver is responsible for the accurate and timely receipt, inventory processing, imaging, and movement of vehicles entering the Oman yard. The role ensures vehicles are properly washed, inventoried, photographed, and processed using handheld devices while maintaining an efficient and safe flow of traffic within the receiving area.
q: Ability to read, write, understand, and communicate effectively in English is mandatory.
Basic ability to use handheld/mobile devices for data entry and vehicle processing.
Good attention to detail and ability to accurately follow defined processes.
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced yard environment and manage multiple incoming vehicles.
Physically fit and comfortable performing outdoor work, including working under the sun and in Oman weather conditions.
Good teamwork, communication, and time-management skills.
Willingness to follow operational procedures and health & safety requirements.
Candidates with any of the following will have an advantage
Automotive/mechanical knowledge or previous automotive industry experience.
Experience in vehicle yards, auctions, logistics, workshops, recovery, or transportation operations.
Forklift operating experience or a valid forklift licence/certification.
Ability to communicate in Arabic, Hindi, or Urdu.
Basic understanding of vehicle makes, models, components, and vehicle damage.

We are looking for a hands-on and reliable individual who is comfortable working outdoors and takes ownership of completing vehicle inventory accurately and on time. The successful candidate should be safety-conscious, physically capable of yard work, comfortable using technology, and able to maintain quality and productivity during high-volume receiving periods.

At Copart, we are focused on harnessing the power of diversity, inclusion, and collaboration. By embracing diverse perspectives, we open doors to innovation and unleash the full potential of our team. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels appreciated, included, and inspired to grow and contribute meaningfully.

r: Receive incoming vehicles and ensure they are processed accurately and efficiently.
Perform vehicle inventory using company-provided handheld devices, ensuring all required vehicle information is captured correctly.
Wash and prepare vehicles prior to the inventory and imaging process.
Capture clear and complete vehicle images in accordance with company imaging and quality standards.
Verify basic vehicle details and identify visible damage, missing components, keys, and other required inventory information.
Direct the flow of vehicles and traffic within the receiving area to avoid congestion and ensure timely processing.
Coordinate with tow truck drivers, transporters, yard operators, and other Operations team members during vehicle receiving and unloading.
Ensure vehicles are moved to the correct designated yard location after inventory processing.
Maintain productivity and quality standards for daily vehicle receiving and inventory activities.
Follow all yard safety procedures, particularly when working around loaders, forklifts, tow trucks, and moving vehicles.
Maintain good housekeeping within the receiving, washing, and inventory areas.
Report vehicle discrepancies, system/device issues, safety concerns, or operational delays to the Yard Supervisor.
Support other yard operational activities as required.

d: You'll build the distributed systems that train Luma's large-scale multimodal models across thousands of GPUs, so researchers can focus on innovation on top of reliable, efficient, scalable infrastructure.

This is hard PyTorch, CUDA, and distributed-systems work — advanced parallelism, training stability, and utilization across massive clusters. It fits an engineer who's solved real problems training foundation models at scale. If you haven't worked at the level of FSDP and multi-node training, this is the wrong depth.
q: Extensive distributed PyTorch training and parallelisms in foundation-model training.
Deep understanding of GPU clusters, networking, and storage systems.
Familiarity with communication libraries (NCCL, MPI) and distributed-system optimization.
Strong Linux systems administration and scripting.
Experience managing training runs across 100+ GPUs.
Experience with containerization, orchestration, and cloud infrastructure.

About Luma: Luma's mission is to build unified general intelligence that can generate, understand, and operate in the physical world. We believe multimodality is critical for intelligence — the next step beyond language models comes from vision. Luma is an equal opportunity employer.
r: Design, implement, and optimize efficient distributed training systems for models across thousands of GPUs.
Research and implement advanced parallelization (FSDP, Tensor Parallel, Pipeline Parallel, Expert Parallel).
Build monitoring, visualization, and debugging tools for large-scale training runs.
Optimize training stability, convergence, and resource utilization across massive clusters.
One way the first 90 could unfold.
Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Learn the current training stack and where stability and utilization hurt at scale.
Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Land a parallelization or stability improvement that measurably helps a real training run.
Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Build the monitoring and tooling that keeps large runs reliable and efficient.

d: Vivid is a technology company specializing in artificial intelligence, predictive intelligence and customer engagement solutions.

Our flagship platform, Sonar, helps businesses understand customer behavior, predict future purchasing decisions, identify customers at risk of disengaging and drive revenue through targeted campaigns and intelligent automation.
By integrating with existing business systems, Sonar enables organizations to make data-driven decisions, strengthen customer relationships and improve operational efficiency.
As we continue to expand across Bahrain and the GCC, we are looking for ambitious individuals who want to contribute to the growth of an innovative technology company.
We are looking for a motivated and results-driven Business Development Executive to join our growing team in Manama, Bahrain.

This is a full-time, on-site position focused on identifying new business opportunities, acquiring clients, building strong customer relationships and driving the adoption of Vivid's technology solutions.

The successful candidate will work closely with the management team throughout the sales cycle, from initial outreach and product demonstrations to negotiations, closing deals and customer onboarding.
Identify and engage prospective clients across various industries.
Generate new business opportunities through cold calling, email outreach, networking and direct prospecting.
Schedule and attend meetings with potential clients.
Conduct product demonstrations and communicate the commercial value of Sonar.
Understand client requirements and recommend suitable solutions.
Manage and follow up with prospective and existing clients.
Prepare commercial proposals and support contract negotiations.
Manage sales opportunities throughout the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to closing.
Assist with customer onboarding and ensure a smooth transition onto the platform.
Maintain accurate records of leads, sales activities and client interactions.
Achieve individual sales targets and contribute to the company's revenue growth.
Identify new market opportunities and support Vivid's expansion across the GCC.
Experience in sales, business development, account management or a related field is preferred.
Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
Confidence in cold calling, prospecting and engaging with business decision-makers.
Ability to build and maintain professional client relationships.
Strong organizational and time management skills.
Interest in technology, artificial intelligence and SaaS solutions.
Ability to understand and communicate technology solutions in clear, business-focused language.
Fluency in English; Arabic is highly preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance or a related field is preferred.
Work in a fast-growing technology company focused on AI and predictive intelligence.
Gain hands-on experience in B2B technology sales and business development.
Work directly with the founding and management teams.
Engage with businesses across multiple industries and markets.
Take ownership of meaningful business opportunities and contribute directly to the company's growth.
Develop your career within a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment.
